name: Erika von Auguschnaiter
original_name: エーリカ・フォン・アウフシュナイター
source:
Grade: High school 1st year student
Ability: EDELWIND (allows Erika to interfere with air flow and atmospheric pressure)
Precise height: 162.3 cm

One of the world's remaining noble families' daughter, Erika wants to restore her family's reputation by becoming the world's greatest. Erika is like a princess due to the way she was raised up: arrogant but refined. Despite this, she loves traditional foods such as croquettes, and will get mad if she can't eat at least one daily.
